items.title: RayNeo IO Review: Just so You Know, My Smart Glasses Are Listening
items.excerpt: Gizmodo reviews the $499 camera-free RayNeo IO smart glasses: AI live translation and a teleprompter are useful, but the optional Lifelog feature that listens all day and keeps text transcripts feels too invasive.
items.rationale: First review of a new camera-free AI glasses model; the always-listening Lifelog feature raises a concrete privacy question for buyers.

items.title: Tamagotchi-style digital pet turns the back of your smartphone into its new home
items.excerpt: A Tamagotchi-style digital pet has found a new home on the back of your smartphone. Beambox's Polly combines magnetic attachment, a touchscreen and AI chat, with Japanese crowdfunding prices starting at ¥10,999 and deliveries planned for January 2027.
items.rationale: New magnetic AI-chat companion accessory with price and ship date; a distinct product from the 11-16 Oats AI Tamagotchi.

items.title: 35-year-old SNES runs ChatGPT, accelerated with a Super FX 2 chip
items.excerpt: Nintendo’s classic SNES console now has its own ChatGPT client, and it's accelerated by the Super FX 2 chip.
items.rationale: Fresh maker hack running a 2.2M-parameter chatbot on SNES cartridge silicon; shows how small on-device language models can go.

items.title: New Hyundai Elantra Hybrid Debuts With 53 Mpg, AI in the Dash
items.excerpt: The redesigned compact sedan features Hyundai’s new AI voice assistant, Gleo AI, and an updated regenerative braking system with EV-like one-pedal driving.
items.rationale: LA Auto Show debut putting Hyundai's new Gleo AI voice assistant into a mass-market compact car; adds an in-car AI angle to the set.
